# Cully v0.8.0

The Codex pane now separates **Model & activity**, **Project & usage**, and **Cully MCP** into three aligned groups on wide terminals. Narrow terminals stack the groups. Rows share consistent spacing within each group, with a separator between sections; the advisor still previews two prioritized comments and opens with Ctrl+] / F6 or a mouse click.

Cully MCP telemetry shows cumulative foreground-session counts for total calls, log, context, recall, search, get and other tools. Only actual named MCP hook events count, and background advisor calls are excluded. Private local aggregates retain tool/MCP totals, verification state, last observed health/authentication, model, context, tokens and quotas under a hashed thread identity. Resuming the same thread restores these instruments when SessionStart identifies it; a different thread starts independently. Concurrent hooks cannot lose updates, and late hooks cannot change a closed pane's saved totals. No arguments, responses, credentials or memory content are saved.

Native cumulative token totals replace saved values without being added twice. Narrow footers keep previously observed instruments when they omit a field. Branch, working-tree changes and daemon status are refreshed live; advisor recommendations are analyzed again from the restored metrics. Existing threads can restore only metrics Cully actually saved, without reading transcripts or inventing past usage.

Health and authentication show the last observed MCP response, independently from daemon status. Successful owner-scoped calls show healthy/authenticated; failures show unhealthy, and explicit authentication errors show unauthenticated. Missing evidence remains unknown. The advisor warns when the observed connection needs attention.

Verified health appears as a green Healthy or red Unhealthy badge in the Cully MCP heading, with authentication below. A new pane clearly says Awaiting first MCP response until a real call arrives; the separate Health row is removed.

Codex cost/cache placeholders are removed when reliable billable-cost data is unavailable. Model, context, token usage, quotas, Git changes and verification remain available. Claude's reported cost is unchanged.

Validation includes Go formatting, vet, race tests, layout bounds, per-session count isolation, concurrent-hook aggregation, authentication recovery, payload-free telemetry and terminal interaction regressions. Release automation publishes binaries and service images; personal deployment remains manual.
